record.question: Which diseases are associated with BRCA1 and BRCA2?
prose_kept: BRCA1 is associated with Familial cancer of breast [1].
BRCA2 is associated with Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 2 [2].
BRCA1 is also associated with Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1 [3].
BRCA2 is associated with Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 2 [5].
The BRCA1 gene product contributes to genomic stability and functions as a tumor suppressor [6].
Its functions include transcription, double-strand-break repair, and recombination [6].
Alternative splicing helps regulate its subcellular localization and physiological function [6].

llm.reply:
BRCA1 is associated with Familial cancer of breast [2]. BRCA2 is associated with Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 2 [9].

## Additional BRCA1 associations

BRCA1 is also associated with Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1 [3]. Its associated conditions include Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4 [4]. The BRCA1-associated disease set also includes Fanconi anemia complementation group S [5].

## BRCA2 cancer associations

BRCA2 is associated with Medulloblastoma [7]. Its associated conditions also include Glioma susceptibility 3 [10]. Another BRCA2-associated condition is Familial prostate cancer [11].

## Other BRCA2 associations

BRCA2 is associated with Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 2 [12]. Its associated disease set also includes Wilms tumor 1 [13]. BRCA2 is additionally associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group D1 [8].

## BRCA1 functional context

The BRCA1 gene product contributes to genomic stability and functions as a tumor suppressor [24: "plays a role in maintaining genomic stability, and it also acts as a tumor suppressor"]. Its functions include transcription, double-strand-break repair, and recombination [24: "This protein thus plays a role in transcription, DNA repair of double-stranded breaks, and recombination"]. Alternative splicing helps regulate its subcellular localization and physiological function [24: "Alternative splicing plays a role in modulating the subcellular localization and physiological function of this gene"].

BRCA1 is associated with Familial cancer of breast [2]. BRCA1 is also associated with Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1 [3]. BRCA2 is associated with Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 2 [9].
